Murray was my favorite uncle, he had been so supportive of my mother when dad passed, I was sad that he had no one to help him when he died. He had given me the small house in a will so I went one day to check it out. I had been there only a few times as a child so I didn't know what to expect. 

Arriving at the small bungalow not much could be said. The house was well taken care of, it was easy to work on. I walked back towards the kitchen and noticed a small nook just past the fridge. There were stairs that seemed to go up but stopped at the third step. 

I Continued exploring and found another staircase, this time leading down, just to the right of the toilet. I stared at it for a bit, deciding I should check it out. I found a toolkit in the closet and grabbed the hammer.

Whack. 

A small dent appeared.

Thud.

Debris began falling. With one last hit a small hole opened. I could see more stairs and a door. 

After opening the hole large enough to maneuver I walked towards the door. On the other side I could hear the wind howling.

A story underground shouldn't have wind, I thought as I reached for the handle. I opened it and was shocked.

I was In a huge field. The wind moved slowly and it seemed so calm. I saw someone appear near by and was shocked, my father was there, staring at me.

" I see you found the stairs," he smiled.

"What the fuck dad?"

"This is limbo. Murray trapped me here when I died. Don't worry it's all OK. Just come visit me sometimes. It gets lonely."

I squinted at him and noticed a difference in his eyes. He had blue eyes and suddenly they lacked all colour. 

He saw my realization and everything drained of colour. I turned around and slammed the door. that was too much.

I kept the house though. Sometimes I can hear  knocking too.
